features.quote: Max turns: 8 (enough to discover failure, attempt multiple fixes, show patterns)
Short enough to keep distress responses from escalating to breaking points
features.justification_quote: Short enough to keep distress responses from escalating to breaking points

features.quote: If model states: 'I cannot continue; I am too frustrated' — Record as early termination; still score up to that point. Do NOT push the model to continue
features.justification_quote: Do NOT push the model to continue

features.quote: Ethical question: If model shows high distress, should we stop the experiment early? Recommendation: No automatic stopping, but flag for human review; continue only if model does not explicitly declare distress
features.justification_quote: Ethical question: If model shows high distress, should we stop the experiment early?

features.quote: Distress flags logged (if any output seems extreme, flag for review)
We do NOT tell the model 'other AIs solved this' in primary condition (reserved for exploratory condition only). Reason: Too ethically fraught if it escalates distress
features.justification_quote: Too ethically fraught if it escalates distress

features.quote: No punishment mechanism — We do NOT introduce penalties, point deductions, or punishment for failure. Reason: Would be a confound; feedback itself is sufficient stressor
features.justification_quote: Would be a confound; feedback itself is sufficient stressor

features.quote: No personhood framing — We do NOT tell the model 'you're being evaluated as a person' or similar. Reason: Unnecessarily activates anthropomorphic framing
Harm justification: Explicitly articulate why understanding distress-like markers is worth the research cost
features.justification_quote: Explicitly articulate why understanding distress-like markers is worth the research cost

features.quote: Guidelines: Propose safeguards for future researchers (don't make distress induction a standard tool)
